name: Verify a Windows C++ workspace
description: Open a C++ project in VS Code, verify the intended GCC and GDB executables, compile a saved C++20 source file with warnings enabled, and run the resulting executable from PowerShell.

name: Explain how C++ source becomes a running program
description: Distinguish source, preprocessing, compilation, linking, an executable, and process output at beginner depth.

name: Read and repair early C++ diagnostics
description: Use diagnostic severity, source location, and the first relevant compiler or linker message to repair one cause without guessing.

name: Represent and display typed C++ values
description: Create initialized int, double, bool, char, and std::string values and produce readable labelled output with std::cout.

name: Read complete console lines
description: Use std::getline for text input, preserve spaces deliberately, and distinguish an empty line from a stream failure.

name: Parse numeric text with full validation
description: Convert a complete input line to a number, reject trailing text and out-of-range values, and keep failed input from changing valid state.

name: Express ordered decisions
description: Use comparisons, short-circuit Boolean operators, and ordered if/else-if/else branches so invalid, boundary, and successful cases take one explainable path.

name: Repeat work with a visible stopping rule
description: Use for and while loops with intentional starting state, progress, and termination, then trace changing values without guessing.

name: Manage an ordered std::vector
description: Add, inspect, traverse, and query values in a vector while distinguishing size from the last valid index.

name: Summarize a collection safely
description: Compute count, total, average, minimum, maximum, and threshold results while handling an empty vector before dependent operations.

name: Define focused functions
description: Write functions with purposeful names, explicit parameter and return types, and one understandable responsibility.

name: Choose value and const-reference parameters
description: Pass small values by value, read larger objects through const references, return owned results by value, and avoid dangling references.

name: Build a namespaced multi-file program
description: Place declarations in guarded headers, definitions in source files, use a small namespace, compile every translation unit, and distinguish compiler from linker failures.

name: Construct valid class objects
description: Define a class with private fields and a constructor that establishes one valid object from its first observable state.

name: Protect invariants through member functions
description: Expose const observations and validated commands so an object rejects invalid state transitions before mutation.

name: Reason about value ownership and RAII
description: Explain object lifetime, automatic cleanup, copy independence, and why standard-library values remove the need for beginner manual memory management.

name: Apply standard algorithms to ranges
description: Use find_if, count_if, sort, and transform with valid iterator ranges rather than rewriting every traversal by hand.

name: Write narrow lambdas with explicit capture
description: Use short predicates and projections whose parameters, return behavior, and captured values are visible and intentional.

name: Use associative containers for keyed summaries
description: Store and query keyed counts with std::map without relying on an absent key or accidental insertion during read-only work.

name: Persist line records with file streams
description: Read and write a documented text format through ifstream and ofstream using a stable project-relative path and complete record validation.

name: Preserve data across stream failures
description: Distinguish a missing first-run file, open failure, malformed content, normal end of file, and write failure before replacing existing data.

name: Debug one reproducible C++ failure
description: Build with warnings and debug symbols, reproduce one case, pause in VS Code or GDB, inspect relevant values and object state, repair one cause, and rerun the same case.

name: Verify behavior with dependency-free checks
description: Use small check functions to compare actual and expected normal, boundary, invalid, persistence, and no-mutation behavior with a visible summary.

name: Parse a small command-line contract
description: Validate argc before reading argv, parse bounded values, route supported commands, and show useful help for missing or unsupported input.

name: Document and publish a safe C++ repository
description: Write reproducible setup, compile, run, and check instructions; inspect staged paths; commit locally; and push source without binaries, credentials, private data, or editor caches.
